issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting reports about continuously failing tests or jobs in Kubernetes CI -->

#### Which jobs are failing:
ci-kubernetes-e2e-gci-gce-serial

#### Which test(s) are failing:
All gce pd csi tests

#### Since when has it been failing:
5/14

#### Testgrid link:
https://k8s-testgrid.appspot.com/sig-storage-kubernetes#gce-serial

#### Reason for failure:
Likely related to the removal of v1beta1 storage objects in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/99840. The provisioner and attacher sidecars need to be updated.

#### Anything else we need to know:
